summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of equity securities under Item 3.02 and a net asset value update under Item 8.01. On April 1, 2026, the company issued 446,369.738 Class I shares at $25.06 per share (aggregate ~$11.186 million) in its continuous private offering. As of March 31, 2026, aggregate NAV was ~$1.018 billion. The offering is ongoing with up to $5.0 billion in shares. This is a standard capital-raising update, not a special situation.
